37722-the-hindoos-as-they-are-a-descript.title: In Bengal.
37722-the-hindoos-as-they-are-a-descript.creator: Unknown
37722-the-hindoos-as-they-are-a-descript.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Babu Shib Chunder Bose is an enlightened Bengali, of matured conviction and character, who, having received the stirring impulse of Western culture and thought during the early period of Dr. Duff's work in the General Assembly's Institution, has continued faithful to it through all these long and changeful years.

51414-so-they-baked-a-cake.title: So They Baked A Cake
51414-so-they-baked-a-cake.creator: Unknown
51414-so-they-baked-a-cake.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. We were the pioneers on the first starship, the first to try out the _Larson Drive_ in deep space. At last, man's travel would be measured in parsecs, for our destination was 26 trillion miles down near the celestial south pole. Not much more than a parsec--but a parsec, nonetheless.

arxiv-1803-06730.title: Combining Probabilistic Load Forecasts Thanks: This work was supported in part by National Key R&D Program of China (No. 2016YFB0900100) ( Corresponding author: Chongqing Kang ) Thanks: Y. Wang, N. Zhang, and C. Kang are with the State Key Lab of Power Systems, Dept. of Electrical Engineering, Tsing
arxiv-1803-06730.creator: Yi Wang, Ning Zhang, Yushi Tan
arxiv-1803-06730.description: Abstract Probabilistic load forecasts provide comprehensive information about future load uncertainties. In recent years, many methodologies and techniques have been proposed for probabilistic load forecasting. Forecast combination, a widely recognized best practice in point forecasting literature, has never been formally adopted to combine probabilistic load forecasts.

arxiv-1907-12693.title: The effects of a compressive velocity pulse on a collapsing turbulent clump
arxiv-1907-12693.creator: G. Arreaga-García \fnmsep
arxiv-1907-12693.description: Abstract High-resolution hydrodynamical simulations are presented to follow the gravitational collapse of a uniform turbulent clump, upon which a purely radial compressive velocity pulse is activated in the midst of the evolution of the clump, when its turbulent state has been fully developed.

arxiv-2210-14114.title: An adaptive multi-fidelity sampling framework for safety analysis of connected and automated vehicles
arxiv-2210-14114.creator: Xianliang Gong, Shuo Feng, Yulin Pan
arxiv-2210-14114.description: Abstract Testing and evaluation are expensive but critical steps in the development of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs). In this paper, we develop an adaptive sampling framework to efficiently evaluate the accident rate of CAVs, particularly for scenario-based tests where the probability distribution of input parameters is known from the Naturalistic Driving Data.

arxiv-2305-18319.title: Automated Feedback Generation for a Chemistry Database and Abstracting Exercise
arxiv-2305-18319.creator: Oscar Morris, Russell Morris
arxiv-2305-18319.description: Abstract Timely feedback is an important part of teaching and learning. Here we describe how a readily available neural network transformer (machine-learning) model (BERT) can be used to give feedback on the structure of the response to an abstracting exercise where students are asked to summarise the contents of a published article after finding it from a publication database.

arxiv-2308-14721.title: Cavity-mediated long-range interactions in levitated optomechanics
arxiv-2308-14721.creator: Jayadev Vijayan, Johannes Piotrowski, Carlos Gonzalez-Ballestero, Kevin Weber, Oriol Romero-Isart, Lukas Novotny
arxiv-2308-14721.description: Abstract The ability to engineer cavity-mediated interactions has emerged as a powerful tool for the generation of non-local correlations and the investigation of non-equilibrium phenomena in many-body systems. Levitated optomechanical systems have recently entered the multi-particle regime, with promise for using arrays of massive strongly coupled oscillators for exploring complex interacting systems and sensing.

arxiv-2406-14373.title: Artificial Leviathan: Exploring Social Evolution of LLM Agents Through the Lens of Hobbesian Social Contract Theory Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2406-14373.creator: Gordon Dai, Weijia Zhang, Jinhan Li, Siqi Yang, Chidera Onochie lbe, Srihas Rao, Arthur Caetano, Misha Sra
arxiv-2406-14373.description: Abstract . The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) and advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) offer an opportunity for computational social science research at scale. Building upon prior explorations of LLM agent design, our work introduces a simulated agent society where complex social relationships dynamically form and evolve over time.

arxiv-2410-07075.title: Effects of DM and KSEA interactions on entanglement, Fisher and Wigner-Yanase information correlations of two XYZ-Heisenberg-qubit states under a magnetic field
arxiv-2410-07075.creator: S. Gaidi, A. Slaoui, A-B. A. Mohamed, M. EL Falaki, R. Ahl Laamara
arxiv-2410-07075.description: Abstract We employ entanglement negativity, local quantum uncertainty (LQU), and local quantum Fisher information (LQFI) to characterize thermal entanglement between two XYZ-Heisenberg-qubit states under the influence of Dzyaloshinsky–Moriya(DM) and Kaplan–Shekhtman–Entin-Wohlman–Aharony (KSEA) interactions, as well as a magnetic field and thermal equilibrium temperature. A comparative examination reveals similar behaviors among these correlation measures.

arxiv-2503-12300.title: On the Chermak-Delgado lattice of a finite group
arxiv-2503-12300.creator: Ryan McCulloch, Marius Tărnăuceanu
arxiv-2503-12300.description: Abstract By imposing conditions upon the index of a self-centralizing subgroup of a group, and upon the index of the center of the group, we are able to classify the Chermak-Delgado lattice of the group. This is our main result.

arxiv-2503-20688.title: Graph-Enhanced Model-Free Reinforcement Learning Agents for Efficient Power Grid Topological Control
arxiv-2503-20688.creator: Eloy Anguiano-Batanero, Ángela Fernández, Álvaro Barbero
arxiv-2503-20688.description: Abstract The increasing complexity of power grid management, driven by the emergence of prosumers and the demand for cleaner energy solutions, has needed innovative approaches to ensure stability and efficiency. This paper presents a novel approach within the model-free framework of reinforcement learning, aimed at optimizing power network operations without prior expert knowledge.

pmc-10668954.title: Performance Evaluation of an Immersive Virtual Reality Application for Rehabilitation after Arthroscopic Rotator Cuff Repair
pmc-10668954.creator: Arianna Carnevale, Ilaria Mannocchi, Emiliano Schena, Marco Carli, Mohamed Saifeddine Hadj Sassi, Martina Marino, Umile Giuseppe Longo, Redha Taiar
pmc-10668954.description: Few studies have evaluated the effectiveness of shoulder rehabilitation in virtual environments. The objective of this study was to investigate the performance of a custom virtual reality application (VR app) with a stereophotogrammetric system considered the gold standard. A custom VR app was designed considering the recommended rehabilitation exercises following arthroscopic rotator cuff repair.

pmc-11360754.title: Effects of Gamma Irradiation on Changes in Chemical Composition and Antioxidant Activity of Euphorbia maculata Callus
pmc-11360754.creator: Gyeong Han Jeong, Shubhpreet Kaur, Youngchul Yoo, Young Bae Ryu, Seo Jun Lee, Kwang-Woo Jung, Moon-Soo Chung, Hyoung-Woo Bai, Jin-Hong Kim, Sungbeom Lee, Tae Hoon Kim, Byung Yeoup Chung, Seung Sik Lee, Nicoleta-Gabriela Hădărugă
pmc-11360754.description: In this study, we investigated the effects of gamma irradiation on the antioxidant activity and metabolite profiles of Euphorbia maculata calli (PC3012). Gamma irradiation at various doses (0, 0.05, 0.5, and 10 kGy) significantly enhanced the 1,1-diphenyl-2-picrylhydrazyl (DPPH) and 2,2′-azino-bis(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulphonic acid (ABTS+) radical scavenging activities of the callus extracts of PC3012 in a dose-dependent manner.

pmc-11483693.title: The face-cube illusion by Jean Beuchet
pmc-11483693.creator: Frédéric Devinck, Christophe Quaireau
pmc-11483693.description: The face-cube illusion was made by Jean Beuchet in 1966 (as indicated in the device) and this effect was not published. For this reason, it seems important to present this visual phenomenon. The effect is obtained from connected curved wire construction presented in three-dimensional space.

pmc-12593894.creator: Aipeng Mao, Xiaoyan Peng, Junning Pu, Yanbin Chen, Qingyue Liu, Jingyi Cai, Hua Zhao, Gang Jia, Gang Tian
pmc-12593894.description: BackgroundGiven the high incidence of gastrointestinal disorders in intensive rabbit production, we assessed the effects of graded levels of xylooligosaccharides (XOS) on growth performance, nutrient digestibility and intestinal health in growing rabbits.MethodsThe 35-day-old weaned rabbits (889.41 ± 0.41 g) were randomly assigned to five dietary treatments (0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4 or 0.

pmc-12619343.title: Precision medicine exploration of postpartum rectus abdominis muscle separation: from basic research to clinical practice
pmc-12619343.creator: MengMeng Huang, Zhihong Huang, Hanzhang Huang
pmc-12619343.description: Postpartum diastasis recti abdominis (PDRA), characterized by pathological separation of the rectus abdominis muscles, affects 30%-60% of women, with many cases persisting beyond 6 months postpartum and having significant impacts on musculoskeletal function and quality of life. This review synthesizes recent advancements across molecular pathogenesis, precision diagnostics, and therapeutic innovations.

pmc-13275285.title: Prognostic significance and model evaluation of the modified advanced lung cancer inflammation index in locally advanced resectable gastric cancer patients with neoadjuvant chemotherapy
pmc-13275285.creator: Weidong Xie, Yaoyu Song, Zhaojie Yu, Huanhao Zhang, Shaoliang Han
pmc-13275285.description: BackgroundSarcopenia is closely associated with poor outcomes in cancer patients. However, its prognostic significance in advanced gastric cancer (GC) patients undergoing neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) remains unclear. This study investigated the prognostic value of the modified Advanced Lung Cancer Inflammation Index (mALI) in this population.MethodsWe retrospectively included 209 patients with locally advanced resectable GC undergoing NAC followed by curative-intent surgery.

pmc-13380466.title: Perioperative Use of Efgartigimod Alfa, a Neonatal Fc Receptor Antagonist, to Reduce Antiphospholipid Antibody Titers and Thrombotic Risk in a Kidney Transplant Recipient
pmc-13380466.creator: Katafan Achkar, Stephanie Yi, George M Nassar, Abdul-Jabbar Khan, Paul M Schroder, Alex W Rogers, Allison N Yun, Ahmed Osama Gaber
pmc-13380466.description: Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) is associated with an increased risk of thrombotic complications after kidney transplantation, particularly in patients with persistently elevated and triple-positive antiphospholipid antibodies (aPLs). Management of APS in kidney transplantation relies primarily on perioperative anticoagulation; however, thrombotic events may still occur despite appropriate therapy in patients with high-risk aPLs.

pmc-13387500.title: Axon Diameter Mapping From Myelin Water Diffusion MRI
pmc-13387500.creator: Hong-Hsi Lee, Kwok-Shing Chan, Dmitry S. Novikov, Els Fieremans, Susie Y. Huang
pmc-13387500.description: Probing diffusion in myelin water using diffusion-weighted T1-/T2-selective MRI acquisitions enables noninvasive measurement of myelinated axon diameter. Its application for in vivo measurements requires numerical verification through diffusion simulations. Here, we propose the theory of myelin water diffusion as measured with a diffusion MRI pulse sequence with wide gradient pulses using the Gaussian phase approximation.

pmc-13538724.title: Real‐World Effectiveness and Safety of a Tubeless Automated Insulin Delivery System With an Adaptive Control Algorithm (APGO) in Children and Adolescents With Type 1 Diabetes: A Multicentre Observational Study
pmc-13538724.creator: Angela Zanfardino, Dario Iafusco, Giorgia Ippolito, Emanuele Miraglia del Giudice, Assunta Serena Rollato, Antonietta Chianese, Adele Figuccia, Sonia Toni, Annalisa Giulia Ferlito, Barbara Piccini

pmc-13607253.title: Bicyclol: A Useful Agent for Silicosis?
pmc-13607253.creator: Te Zhang, Tong-Tong Liu, Xiao-Jie Wang, Hong-Chao Du, Yan-Xing Han, Yun Zhan, Jian-Dong Jiang
pmc-13607253.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Silicosis is one of the most prevalent occupational diseases worldwide, resulting from prolonged exposure to crystalline silica (SiO2). This exposure leads to persistent inflammation, lung fibrosis, and ultimately significant loss of lung function and death. Although the precise mechanisms remain unclear, the primary molecular pathogenesis of silicosis—ranging from SiO2-induced chronic inflammation to irreversible pulmonary fibrosis—shares considerable overlap with fibrosis mechanisms in various organs, including the secretion of inflammatory cytokines, the activation of fibrosis-related signaling pathways, and ferroptosis.

uslaw-usc-t42-s16233.title: 42 U.S.C. § 16233 — Low-cost renewable hydrogen and infrastructure for vehicle propulsion
uslaw-usc-t42-s16233.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s16233.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 149 (National Energy Policy And Programs); Subchapter IX (Research And Development); Part C (Renewable Energy). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall— (1) establish a research, development, and demonstration program to determine the feasibility of using hydrogen propulsion in light-weight vehicles and the integration of the associated hydrogen production infrastructure.
